ideas.children_he: ה׳ הוּא מֶלֶךְ קָדוֹשׁ וְנִשְׂגָּב, וּמַלְכוּתוֹ מְבֻסֶּסֶת עַל מִשְׁפָּט צֶדֶק.
ideas.children_en: God is a holy, exalted King whose rule rests on justice.

ideas.children_he: הָעָם נִקְרָא לְכַבֵּד אֶת ה׳, שֶׁעָנָה לְמֹשֶׁה, אַהֲרֹן וּשְׁמוּאֵל וְגַם תִּקֵּן אוֹתָם.
ideas.children_en: The people are called to honor God, who answered Moses, Aaron, and Samuel and also corrected them.

ideas.children_he: הַשִּׁיר מִסְתַּיֵּם בִּקְרִיאָה לְהִשְׁתַּחֲווֹת בְּהַר הַקֹּדֶשׁ, כִּי ה׳ קָדוֹשׁ.
ideas.children_en: The song ends by calling for worship at the holy mountain, because God is holy.
